marks.selector: circle, circle.dot, circle[class*='dot'], circle[class*='point'], circle[class*='obs'], g.cell circle, g.panel circle, g[class*='cell'] circle, g[class*='panel'] circle
marks.note: 12 off-diagonal panels × 150 obs = 1800 circles; min=400 allows sparse builds or partial panels; max=2500 allows 16 panels including diagonal scatter.

panels.selector: g.cell, g.panel, g[class*='cell'], g[class*='panel'], g[class*='subplot'], g[class*='facet'], rect.pane, rect[class*='pane'], rect[class*='frame'], g.dots-group, svg > g[transform]
panels.note: 4×4 grid = 16 panels; min=9 allows 3×3 or partial. rect.pane matches deepseek-style per-cell background rect (one per panel). g.dots-group also matches deepseek scatter groups. Max=60 allows rect.pane + g.dots-group counted together.

axes.note: At least one axis per outer panel edge; full implementation has up to 8 labeled outer axes × N ticks.

count_badge.note: Live count of brushed observations; updates as brush changes. text.badge-text added 2026-05-03 for deepseek-style SVG text badge.

brush.note: Drag on brush group. rect.overlay added 2026-05-03: d3.brush always creates rect.overlay inside the brush g; models that skip class='brush' on the parent g are matched via rect.overlay.

link.note: Brushing one panel changes circle opacity in all other panels; DOM diff detects opacity/class attribute changes.

notes: Fingerprint intentionally permissive: SPLOM implementations vary widely in panel container class names.
Brush trigger is the brush group itself; inner selection rect is zero-size before user interaction.
Panel count min=9 tolerates 3×3 SPLOMs (omitting same-dimension panels), common in simpler builds.
